description: A generic, app-independent ticket, so the evals do not only measure one TripBuilder story.

ticket.description:
Users who forgot their password can request a reset link from the sign-in page.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
1. The sign-in page has a 'Forgot password?' link that opens /reset-password.
2. The reset page has an Email field and a 'Send reset link' button.
3. The button is disabled until the Email field contains a syntactically valid address.
4. Submitting calls POST /api/auth/reset-requests and returns 202.
5. After submitting, the page shows 'If an account exists for that email, we sent a reset link.' whether or not the account exists.
6. Submitting more than 5 times in 10 minutes shows 'Too many requests. Try again later.'
